full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the disposal of the appeal are that one Chand Mia, predecessor-in-interest of the appellants, instituted Title Suit No.53 of 1990 in the Second Court of Subordinate Judge seeking rectification of a deed and declaration of title in respect of the third schedule land claiming that he was the owner of the suit land on the basis of four deeds and the Khatian was also prepared in his name. Subsequently, he sold the second schedule land measuring an area of 0028 decimals to the defendants by registered kabala dated 10th December, 1965. Thereafter, the defendants attempted to encroach into the plaintiffs land when they disclosed that they had purchased the suit land measuring 05 decimals by the said deed. The plaintiff thereupon obtained a copy of the deed and came to know that the defendants fraudulently included 03 decimals more land in the schedule of the deed although he sold only 0028 decimals. He claimed that he did not sell 05 decimals of land to the defendants and that the deed so far as it relates to the excess area of land was forged, which was required to be rectified.
